beyond.title: Flocking (NetLogo)
beyond.line: Each bird's track rising with time: random flight near the floor, flocks higher up.
beyond.label: recorded NetLogo run · NetLogo bridge
legend: is one bird's track. The floor is NetLogo's world; height is time, tick 0 at the floor to tick 300 at the top.
is a bird in flight. Near the floor the tracks cross every which way; higher up they run side by side: flocks.
mark alignment, how far the birds' headings agree: half at tick 49, nine in ten at tick 81, 0.98 by the end.
is the 71 x 71 patch world. It wraps at its edges, so a track that leaves one side comes back on the other.
at the back corner counts ticks, a mark every 60.

beyond.title: Wolf Sheep Predation (NetLogo)
beyond.line: The predator-prey cycle rising in time: sheep across, wolves front to back, ticks up.
beyond.label: recorded NetLogo run · NetLogo bridge
legend: is both populations at once: sheep across the floor, wolves front to back, rising with time. Each turn of it is one cycle.
is the classic phase plot, the same loop seen from above.
carries the number of sheep against time, the other (in violet) the wolves: the two waves, a little out of step.
show the first sheep peak (tick 80) and the wolves' peak 61 ticks later: predators follow their prey.
counts ticks, 0 to 1,500, a mark every 300. Counts are smoothed over 25 ticks.

beyond.title: Fire (NetLogo)
beyond.line: The fire's front, every few ticks, raised to its tick as it crosses the forest.
beyond.label: recorded NetLogo run · NetLogo bridge
legend: is the fire's front at one moment, drawn every 26 ticks and lifted to its tick, so the burn climbs as it crosses the forest.
of stacked fronts is a pocket that kept burning long after the front had passed.
mark half the burn done (tick 220) and the front reaching the far edge (tick 392).
is the last tree to catch, at tick 664, in a pocket left behind.
is the forest, 251 x 251 patches, lit along its left edge. Where nothing burned, nothing is drawn.
